statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (ICD-10 I34.0)
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service is intended to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is clinically necessary to evaluate the dizziness and giddiness for potential arrhythmia
